# SHEMIRANI Jewelry

> Fine jewellery designed and made by Abbas Shemirani — custom 18K gold and diamond rings,
> hand- and computer-designed and released in strictly limited editions. Based in Karaj, Iran;
> serving clients in Iran and three other countries.

Abbas Shemirani has 7+ years of experience in jewellery ideation, hand and CAD design, and gold
production, building on his father's 35 years in jewellery-making and stone-setting. He holds two
national and two international jewellery-design certificates and an entrepreneurship certificate.

## Designs
- [SERAVÉL](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/seravel/): SERAVÉL is a solitaire band ring in 18K gold — a 0.44 ct, 5 mm diamond in four prongs on a wide fluted band edged with rows of diamonds; 43 diamonds, 0.76 ct in total.
- [AVELIS](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/avelis/): AVELIS is a set of a pendant and earrings in 18K gold — a pavé-edged teardrop pendant filled with gold scrolls, and matching six-stone diamond flower earrings; 41 diamonds, 0.26 ct.
- [ORVESSA](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/orvessa/): ORVESSA is a cluster ring in 18K gold — three concentric rings of diamonds rising in steps to a raised centre stone, on sweeping shoulders; 57 diamonds, 0.48 ct.
- [KAVÉRIN](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/kaverin/): KAVÉRIN are stud earrings in 18K gold — two parallel diamond-set bars on the diagonal with polished gold loops woven between them; 22 diamonds (0.13 ct) per earring.
- [LUMÉRIA](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/lumeria/): LUMÉRIA are statement drop earrings in 18K gold — three pavé leaves over a wide disc with two pavé rings and a swinging pavé diamond-shaped drop; 136 diamonds (0.87 ct) per earring.
- [ELUNÉ](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/elune/): ELUNÉ is a band ring in 18K gold — a polished band with bevelled edges and a single 2.5 mm diamond (0.06 ct) set in a recessed cross-channel.
- [VIRELUNE](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/virelune/): VIRELUNE is a solitaire ring in 18K gold — a 0.47 ct, 5 mm round diamond in a tapered four-prong head, with a row of diamonds in a pointed channel on each shoulder; 13 diamonds, 0.62 ct in total.
- [THÉVORA](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/thevora/): THÉVORA are drop earrings in 18K gold — a diamond-set scroll curling into a spiral, with a round drop holding a seven-stone diamond flower; 28 diamonds (0.19 ct) per earring.
- [ZARELLE](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/zarelle/): ZARELLE is a solitaire ring in 18K gold — a 0.81 ct, 6 mm round diamond in a six-prong head, with woven gold strands in each shoulder framed by two rows of diamonds; 37 diamonds, 1.04 ct in total.
- [SOLVÉRA](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/solvera/): SOLVÉRA is a halo bypass ring in 18K gold — a 0.75 ct oval diamond (7.2 × 5.3 mm) in a pavé halo, with shoulders that sweep past each other; 37 diamonds, 0.96 ct in total.
- [VELORA](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/velora/): VELORA is a heart pendant in 18K gold — two diamond-set strands and a plain gold sweep drawing a heart, under a double ribbon bail; 37 diamonds, 0.29 ct.
- [AUREVÉ](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/aureve/): AUREVÉ is a pear halo pendant in 18K gold — a pear diamond in a halo of prong-set round stones, under a twisted gold ribbon bail set with diamonds; 22 diamonds in all.
- [IMPERIO](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/imperio/): IMPERIO is a pendant in 18K gold — a 1.20 ct pear diamond (9 × 6 mm) hung from a looping gold ribbon set with small diamonds; 14 diamonds, 1.28 ct in total.
- [LUMIÈRE](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/lumiere/): LUMIÈRE is a cluster pendant in 18K gold — 36 round diamonds (0.45 ct) on a domed cluster, their prongs radiating like rays of light, under a polished gold dome.
- [ASTERION](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/asterion/): ASTERION is a pendant in 18K gold with 61 diamonds (0.36 ct) — a pavé-lined teardrop frame around a pear-shaped diamond cluster, with sculpted gold leaves under a diamond-set loop.
- [CROWNELLE](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/crownelle/): CROWNELLE is a halo pendant in 18K gold — a 1.61 ct oval diamond (9.5 × 6.5 mm) in four prongs inside a pavé halo, under a crown-like diamond scroll; 46 diamonds, 1.84 ct in total.
- [SOVRANA](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/sovrana/): SOVRANA is a men's ring in 18K gold with 17 diamonds (0.14 ct) — three prong-set rows on a flat rectangular top, the middle row raised, with three open slots through each tapered shoulder.
- [ROYALE](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/royale/): ROYALE is a solitaire ring in 18K gold — a 5.8 mm, 0.73 ct round diamond in a six-prong head, with one shoulder sweeping around the stone in a single curve.
- [MONARCH](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/monarch/): MONARCH is a wide band ring in 18K gold with 55 diamonds (0.38 ct) — a row of overlapping oval gold discs, each set with a diamond, framed by pavé rows on both edges.
- [VALORIA](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/valoria/): VALORIA is a solitaire ring in 18K gold with 25 diamonds (0.97 ct) — a 6 mm, 0.81 ct centre diamond in a four-prong head, with pavé clusters on the shoulders and triangular pavé insets along the band.
- [SOVEREIGN](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/sovereign/): SOVEREIGN is an 18K gold hinged bangle with 37 diamonds (about 0.20 ct), pavé-set in a long row and a short block — a statement of confidence, independence and power.
- [REGALIA](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/regalia/): REGALIA is a men's signet ring in 18K gold with 16 diamonds (0.36 ct) — a four-diamond flower at its heart, framed in gold for a quiet, lasting presence.
- [IMPERIA](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/imperia/): IMPERIA is a men's ring in 18K gold with 17 diamonds (0.19 ct) — an eight-point star around a bezel-set centre stone, with Greek-key shoulders.
- [AURELIS](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/aurelis/): AURELIS is a men's ring in 18K gold with 47 diamonds (0.61 ct) — a woven gold top edged with pavé rows and a single centre stone.
